Two weeks ago, #Florida passed one of the most regressive anti-free speech laws in modern history. How can organizers protect themselves against attempts at stifling their voices? Tune in Monday! 

#MondaysWithMelba #freespeech #protest #cjreform #blm #policereform   #FlaPol https://t.co/9XmSVKVWGY

Sadly in 2021 “the talk” is still needed.

Join @tamekahobbs, Tangie Sands & I for @FLJusticeCenter pre-Mother’s Day event on what Black #motherhood looks like, how the talk has changed over time & what’s next in policing post #ChauvinTrial
#blackmoms #blm #cjreform #policereform https://t.co/rGhbtbHYy0

The #Florida Legislative session is over; it was nothing nice for progressives. On today’s #MondaysWithMelba, I discuss what passed, lawsuits pending & what’s next in the run up to ‘22 elections. Tune in!

#mondaymotivation #freespeech #blm #cjreform #lgbtq #votersuppression https://t.co/XOwwst1ovL

This week was the 100th anniversary of the #Tulsa Massacre. 
Those who don’t know #history are doomed to repeat it. We must come to terms with our past, repair the damage & take clear steps to make sure it doesn’t happen again. Tune in! 
#MondayMotivation #BLM #factsmatter https://t.co/OIcPjxT9y2

3/3 In honor of this day, attend an in person or virtual event. Learn. @NMAAHC is hosting a series of workshops today virtually. If you are in Miami, @HungryBlackMan1 is hosting an event at the North Beach Bandshell. 
#juneteenth #blm #residentlegaldiva #blackhistory #history https://t.co/RmQy4fGDhN
